description: Run a Puppet Inspector profile against a node and POST normalized compliance.v1 results to the console. Self-contained (bundles the inspector-report adapter). Does NOT install puppet-inspector -- it's pre-alpha with no published release channel yet, so the binary must already be present on the target (see https://github.com/souldo/puppet-inspector).

console_url.description: Console base URL to POST results to (server-injected).

profile.description: Path to the Inspector profile YAML to run, already present on the target.

inspector_path.description: Path to the puppet-inspector binary on the target.
